__doc__: Wine records whose regulator source genuinely names no grape variety. Keyed by slug → {reason, source}. Reviewed entries report as REVIEWED in scripts/audit_empty_grapes.py and are excluded from --strict. Add an entry only after reading the source; an empty list caused by a parser miss stays FLAGGED.

vlaamse-landwijn.reason: The BGA productdossier §7 states the broad IGP rule ('Vitis vinifera of kruisingen') and enumerates no variety.

appenzell-ausserrhoden.reason: Cantonal règlement defers to the federal OVin and catalogues no variety locally.

appenzell-innerrhoden.reason: Cantonal règlement defers to the federal OVin and catalogues no variety locally.

basel-stadt.reason: BS defers to BL through an inter-cantonal Vereinbarung; no own variety list.

nidwalden.reason: Cantonal règlement defers to the federal OVin and catalogues no variety locally.

schwyz.reason: Cantonal règlement defers to the federal OVin and catalogues no variety locally.

uri.reason: Cantonal règlement defers to the federal OVin and catalogues no variety locally.

bern-berne.reason: RebG 916.141.1 Art. 6 Abs. 1: 'gilt das eidgenössische Richtsortiment' — the cantonal act adopts the federal variety list and names none (sub-denominations Bielersee, Thunersee inherit).

glarus.reason: Kantonale Weinbauverordnung IX D/621/1 Art. 9 Rebsortenliste: 'Der Regierungsrat legt die zulässigen Rebsorten fest' — list kept outside the act.

jura.reason: Ordonnance 916.141 Art. 12 Cépages: authorises the OIV list for Switzerland and varieties in the cadastre viticole for > 5 years; no variety enumerated.

schaffhausen.reason: Weinverordnung 817.402 § 12 Rebsorten: 'Das kantonale Sortenverzeichnis wird vom Landwirtschaftsamt geführt' — Anhang 1 holds only Prädikat definitions.

solothurn.reason: Vereinbarung SO–BL 516.34 § 1 Abs. 2: SO applies the Basel-Landschaft Pflanzenbau-Verordnung Kapitel C Weinbau (BL's Anhang 1 roster is extracted on basel-landschaft).

thurgau.reason: Verordnung zum LwG 910.11 § 37 Abs. 1: 'Die Fachstelle führt die Liste der zugelassenen Rebsorten' — list kept outside the act.

zug.reason: Reglement AOC 924.25 § 4 Abs. 1: varieties are those of the federal Rebsortenverordnung SR 916.151.7, by reference.

zurich.reason: LS 916.51 was repealed 01.01.2018 with no successor in the LS (§ 12c of the repealed text kept the register at the Amt für Landschaft und Natur); ZH runs on the federal Weinverordnung + ALN Rebsortenliste.
